text:
maria: Quick idea — community drop that bundles three things: 1) 3 micro-tutorials (quickstart + one advanced tip each), 2) a mini-benchmark narrative showing latency/cost tradeoffs for open models, and 3) a gated webinar for deeper walkthroughs. Need owners for tutorials, bench story, landing + lead routing.

lee_engineer: I can take the mini-bench. want to show 2 model variants (quantized vs fp16) across 128/512 context. short table + a perf graph.

sam_devrel: I'll own the tutorials and the reference app repo. plan: one-click quickstart (docker), one notebook, one small backend example (express). aim to open PR by Tue. :rocket:

olivia_pm: Webinar + landing: funnel must tag leads with "dev-webinar" and "community-bench" in HubSpot. Also capture org size and primary use-case. Can we route paid leads to AE queue and community signups to nurture?

maria: Yes. routing: paid -> sales.others, community -> marketing-nurture. Draft messaging: "Ship high-performance inference with Redwood: quickstart, perf benchmarks, and a live deep-dive." Thoughts?

lee_engineer: Messaging note — call out "predictable latency at Xms P95" instead of vague 'fast'. ops folks care about SLO numbers.

sam_devrel: For the refapp repo I'll add a tiny demo that reproduces the bench numbers and a script to run on local GPU. Will include a Dockerfile + README with copy-paste commands.

maria: Timeline proposal: content drafts by Wed (3 days), design assets by Fri, landing up Mon next week, webinar scheduled 2 weeks out. Can the team hit this?

lee_engineer: Yep for draft bench by Wed. I'll commit raw numbers and a simple plot.

sam_devrel: Tutorials draft done Wed. I'll drop the repo link in this thread when PR is up.

olivia_pm: I'll set up the HubSpot form and routing today. Here's the payload mapping I need from eng (example):
```yaml
webhook_to_hubspot:
  endpoint: https://hooks.hubspot.com/webforms/v1/submit
  fields:
    - name: email
      map_from: user.email
    - name: company
      map_from: user.org
    - name: lead_source
      map_value: community-bench
  tags: [dev-webinar, community-bench]
  route_rules:
    - if: company.is_enterprise
      route: sales.ae_queue
    - else:
      route: marketing.nurture_queue
```

maria: @lee_engineer can you drop a tiny JSON endpoint that posts bench results to that webhook? minimal auth ok for staging.

lee_engineer: Yup. I'll add a small lambda and a curl example. planning to use a short HMAC key for staging. Example curl: `curl -X POST -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"email":"test@example.com","company":"Acme","lead_source":"community-bench"}' https://staging.hub.redwood/webhook`

sam_devrel: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/refapp-micro-tutorials/pull/12 — includes quickstart, Dockerfile, and a notebook. still adding README snippet for the benchmark reproduction.

deploy-bot: deploy:bench-runner to staging succeeded — logs: "bench-runner v0.3 — 3 tasks completed" (build #245). :white_check_mark:

maria: Perfect. Next steps: 1) olivia finalize HubSpot form + share URL, 2) lee add webhook + bench payload sample, 3) sam finalize README and add short tl;dr for marketing. I'll draft the launch post headers and share by EOD for copy review. :thumbsup:

olivia_pm: HubSpot form created: https://app.hubspot.com/forms/12345/dev-webinar — routing tested to staging queues. I'll share live link after we have final copy.

lee_engineer: Webhook + example pushed to repo under /tools/hubspot-webhook.md — includes HMAC example and sample output.

sam_devrel: README updated with a 2-min TL;DR for marketing and a short GIF demo of the refapp. PR ready for final review.

maria: Great work team. I'll schedule a quick triage sync tomorrow 9:30am to make sure design + copy align.

olivia_pm: adding calendar invite.

maria: thanks everyone — will loop in design after the sync.
